newsitem.title: USA: Mellon in definitive agreement to buy Buck.
newsitem.headline: Mellon in definitive agreement to buy Buck.

text.p: Mellon Bank Corp said Friday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Buck Consultants Inc, a global benefits consulting firm. The companies had signed a letter of intent regarding the transaction in December.
Buck shareholders, said the companies, will have the option to receive Mellon common stock or cash, and Mellon has authorized the repurchase of its common stock to pay for the acquisition.
Other terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

Upon completion of the transaction, which is subject to regulatory approval and the approval of Buck's shareholders, Buck will operate as a Mellon subsidiary under the direction of its current management team, retaining its identity and its operational and professional independence.
